result.Method of Attack: Phishing email with malicious Excel document exploiting CVE-2017-0199 to download HTA file; HTA file executes obfuscated JavaScript, VBScript, and PowerShell to download Loader module; Loader module extracts, decrypts, and loads multiple modules including Deploy and core modules; Deploy module establishes persistence via scheduled tasks and performs process hollowing; Core module collects sensitive data including saved credentials from over 50 popular software; Stolen credentials are exfiltrated via SMTP email to attacker
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious Excel attachment exploiting CVE-2017-0199 vulnerability
